kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.02.instructions: On a ledge near a shophouse. Accessible from the entrance of the world.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.03.instructions: On a wall section near the Bailey.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.04.instructions: Top left, back. Accessible by climbing a big pile of furniture.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.05.instructions: Acquired after Sora obtains his new clothes from the Fairies. Piece #5 is a mandatory puzzle piece: a cutscene will be played upon leaving the room.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.06.instructions: Look beside the broken furniture against the west wall.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.08.instructions: Accessible by riding the air currents and jumping.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.09.instructions: From the entrance, go straight and turn right.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.10.instructions: Atop a small pile of furniture.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.11.instructions: Hidden behind a pile of fireworks.

kh2fm.puzzle.awakening.12.instructions: On a haystack behind a house.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.01.instructions: Above the trumpet player bonsai cutting.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.03.instructions: Jump toward the crown above the eastern ramp.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.05.instructions: Found in the cave behind the crates of gunpowder.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.06.instructions: On top of Mog's Moogle Shop. Accessible by High Jump LV2. Alternatively, LV1 High Jump and Reflect can be used.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.07.instructions: At the opposite end of the Rampart from the save point.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.09.instructions: Jump from the north ledge toward the crown over the mist.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.10.instructions: Near the pole on the left side of the pedestal near Shang's tent.

kh2fm.puzzle.heart.11.instructions: On a low rooftop. Reach it with High Jump.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.01.instructions: Under the ledge to the left of the save point.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.03.instructions: Above the archway. Route: use LV3 High Jump or Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.04.instructions: Hidden behind one of the crates of gunpowder.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.05.instructions: Above a stand near the entrance to the Palace Gates.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.06.instructions: By the exit towards the Atrium. Instead of going straight in, stray off a little to the right.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.07.instructions: On the stairs to the Restoration Site.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.08.instructions: Stand on the metal grate to be hit by a jet of green water. This will propel Sora high enough to get the puzzle piece.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.09.instructions: Above the tree upon entering. Route: use LV2 High Jump.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.10.instructions: At the back of the lock.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.11.instructions: Near the first set of exploding crates of gunpowder upon entry.

kh2fm.puzzle.duality.12.instructions: Near the trombone player bonsai cutting is a tall hedge. Jump from the top of the hedge to get puzzle piece.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.01.instructions: To the right of the doors to the station in the northeast corner.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.03.instructions: Behind a stall near exit to the Bazaar. Destroy the stand.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.04.instructions: Above the Corridors doorway. Jump with High Jump LV2 and Aerial Dodge LV1 to reach it.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.05.instructions: On top of the northernmost building's rooftop.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.06.instructions: On the pier next to the river.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.07.instructions: Above exploding gunpowder crates. Route: use LV2 High Jump.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.08.instructions: Above the large boulder near the entrance. Jump from the rock using High Jump LV2 and Aerial Dodge LV1.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.09.instructions: Go through the middle entrance to the Bazaar and there will be a stand with a puzzle piece behind it. Destroy the stand to get it.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.10.instructions: Inside the first chamber and on top of a lone pillar.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.11.instructions: Jump above the bubbling brazier behind the throne on its northwest side.

kh2fm.puzzle.frontier.12.instructions: Jump above the bubbling brazier behind the throne on its northeast side.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.02.instructions: Left from the entrance behind a rock column.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.04.instructions: Dash off of the waterfall basin and then jump to get piece.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.05.instructions: On the steps going down and around the central area.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.06.instructions: Hidden behind a pile of treasure to the left of the entrance.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.07.instructions: Above Pooh's house. Route: use LV2 High Jump.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.08.instructions: Above the awning above the Moogle Shop. Route: use LV2 High Jump and LV2 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.09.instructions: Left side of the room. Route: use LV2 High Jump and Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.10.instructions: In midair while falling down to the next level.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.11.instructions: In midair while falling down to the next level.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.14.instructions: Route: use LV2 High Jump and LV2 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.15.instructions: Right side of the room. Route: use LV3 Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.16.instructions: Route: use LV2 High Jump, Aerial Dodge and attack.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.17.instructions: Route: use LV3 Glide. Alternatively, LV3 High Jump, LV3 Aerial Dodge, and LV1 Glide can be used after jumping from the highest point.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.23.instructions: After traveling to the Other Twilight Town.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.24.instructions: Collect the crown on the floor in the middle of the chamber.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.25.instructions: Use skateboard or Glide to reach it.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.27.instructions: Ride the tram to reach it on the Synthesis shop roof.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.28.instructions: Route: use LV2 Glide and LV2 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.30.instructions: Dash off of the big ledge in the middle.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.31.instructions: Return with Sora and collect the crown in front of his pod.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.32.instructions: Enter from outside; collect the crown on the floor to your right.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.33.instructions: In the wreckage that has a hole through it.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.34.instructions: Route: use Aerial Dodge to get piece hidden behind the pillar.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.36.instructions: Collect the crown at floor level inside the captain’s cabin.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.37.instructions: Fall on it to get it.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.38.instructions: On the top ledge in area with the computer.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.39.instructions: Route: use LV2 Aerial Dodge to reach it.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.40.instructions: Route: use LV2 High Jump and Aerial Dodge. On the second column.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.41.instructions: On broken bridge to the tower.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.43.instructions: In front of the statue's face. Route: use LV2 High Jump and Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.46.instructions: On the first column. Route: use LV2 High Jump and Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.daylight.48.instructions: Under the tree near the entrance to the Wastelands.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.01.instructions: In the area with yellow colored orbs. Route: use LV3 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.02.instructions: Jump off the top of the hill.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.03.instructions: Collect the crown at floor level.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.04.instructions: Atop the building across from Merlin's House. Route: use LV3 High Jump. Alternatively, LV1 High Jump, Wisdom Form, and Reflect can be used.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.05.instructions: Collect the crown at floor level inside the wreck’s hold.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.06.instructions: On a ledge under the door to the Mineshaft. Route: use Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.07.instructions: On top of lone building near the track.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.08.instructions: At the top waterfall. Route: use LV2 High Jump and LV2 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.09.instructions: On the column in the middle of the room. Route: use High Jump.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.10.instructions: Atop column. Route: use Glide and LV2 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.11.instructions: Above the entrance. Route: use LV3 Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.12.instructions: Route: use LV3 Aerial Dodge. Alternatively, LV2 Aerial Dodge and Reflect can be used.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.13.instructions: On bench next to the mini clock tower.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.14.instructions: On the top of the middle mining drill near an air vent.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.15.instructions: Route: use High Jump. Jump off of the staircase leading up to the tower.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.16.instructions: Route: use LV2 High Jump and LV2 Aerial Dodge to jump on to platform. Then use the air vent to reach a higher moving platform.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.17.instructions: Above the second to last platform. Route: use Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.19.instructions: Under the ledge with the treasure chest containing the Map. Route: use Glide or LV3 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.20.instructions: Route: use LV2 Glide. Alternatively, LV3 High Jump and LV3 Aerial Dodge can be used.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.22.instructions: Check the desk at the back of the wardrobe room.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.23.instructions: Atop the pile of gold to the right of the entrance. Route: use LV3 High Jump.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.24.instructions: Collect the crown above the table.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.25.instructions: Route: use LV2 Aerial Dodge or skateboard.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.26.instructions: Check the floor near the northern exit.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.27.instructions: On the top of the highest mining drill.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.28.instructions: Cross to the far end of the bridge. It becomes accessible during the Xaldin fight.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.29.instructions: Jump off the side of Pride Rock.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.30.instructions: In the area with blue orbs. Route: use LV1 Quick Run and LV2 Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.32.instructions: In the area with white orbs. Route: use LV3 Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.33.instructions: Attack anchor to get behind it.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.34.instructions: Collect the crown at floor level.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.35.instructions: Collect the crown at floor level.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.36.instructions: In the area with white orbs. Route: use LV3 Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.37.instructions: Route: use Glide and Aerial Dodge.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.38.instructions: Drop from the southwest ledge toward the crown.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.40.instructions: First piece in the area with white orbs. Route: use LV3 Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.41.instructions: Route: use LV2 High Jump. Jump off one of the booths.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.42.instructions: Route: use LV3 Aerial Dodge and LV2 Glide.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.44.instructions: Cross the canyon toward the suspended crown using Glide LV2.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.46.instructions: On the other side of entrance.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.47.instructions: Route: use LV2 High Jump. Alternatively, LV1 High Jump and Reflect can be used.

kh2fm.puzzle.sunset.48.instructions: Behind the closed door that leads to the Heartless Manufactory.
